_why: WSG-3. `.done` is never written by a 6a-prime `exec agy` dispatch because nothing asks for it -- `_read_report_channel` records that as deliberate, since requiring the marker would send every report to the fallback and undo the channel. So the observation was correct and the implied fix (make agy write one) is the thing already rejected. The real defect was one file over: `failure-recovery.md`'s recovery row covers 6a-prime and prescribed a bare `report-wait`, which polls for that marker and so exits 1 on a COMPLETE report after burning the full timeout (measured: rc=1 after timeout, rc=0 immediately with --no-done-marker, same file). A single clause in a long table cell is exactly the kind of documented rule nobody enforces.

mutations.name: the-recovery-row-drops-the-marker-opt-out
mutations._mechanism: The state before this change. An operator recovering a 6a-prime no_verdict runs the prescribed wait, it blocks 300s on a marker this channel never writes, exits 1 on a complete verdict-carrying report, and the cycle is re-dispatched over finished work.
mutations.find: **For 6a-prime, that wait needs `--no-done-marker` and the others must NOT have it.**
mutations.replace: The wait is the same for every phase.

mutations.name: the-marker-becomes-the-default-again
mutations._mechanism: The opposite error, guarded because the flag's own comment warns about it: flipping `require_marker` to default-off turns the marker contract off for phases 3/4/5b too, where the codex templates DO create it and it is the only thing keeping a half-written audit report unreadable.

mutations.name: the-flag-is-attached-to-the-wrong-leg
mutations._mechanism: The review's case C, which the FIRST version of this guard test passed. Keeping `--no-done-marker` on the line while attaching it to a different leg leaves a 6a-prime row prescribing a bare wait -- and a line-level co-occurrence check cannot tell the difference, because a very long table cell is exactly where a flag and the prescription it belongs to drift apart while still sharing a physical line.
mutations.find: **For 6a-prime, that wait needs `--no-done-marker` and the others must NOT have it.**
